name: tektonic-workspace
description: Workspace root for @pfenerty/tektonic and its provider packages

scripts.test: npm run lint:imports && npm run build && npm run typecheck && vitest run
scripts.lint:scripts: npm run build && node packages/tektonic/dist/cli/index.js lint
scripts.synth: npm run build && node packages/tektonic/dist/cli/index.js synth examples/self-ci.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && node packages/tektonic/dist/cli/index.js check examples/self-ci.ts
scripts.graph: npm run build && node packages/tektonic/dist/cli/index.js graph examples/self-ci.ts
